{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS082 |prevtitle=Eradicate Raticate! |nextcode=PS084 |nexttitle=Clefabulous Clefable |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Bang the Drum, Slowbro |title_ja=VSヤドラン |title_ro=VS Yadoran |image=PS083.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 83 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|7}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 43 in [[Yellow Beginnings]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 83 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|7}} |location=[[Cerise Island]] }} '''Bang the Drum, Slowbro''' (Japanese: '''VSヤドラン''' ''VS {{tt|Yadoran|Slowbro}}'') is the 83rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 43rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The story begins with the [[Cinnabar Gym]] being attacked by [[Lance]]'s dragons. Then the scenario changes to the place where [[Sabrina]], who is tied to an unconscious {{Adv|Green}}, battles [[Lorelei]]'s {{p|Slowbro}} with her {{p|Alakazam}}. Sabrina orders it to use {{m|Psychic}}, but Slowbro appears to be unaffected. Lorelei then says that Slowbro used {{m|Amnesia}} to make itself immune to the attack. She reveals how she knew about their presence, using {{p|Shellder}}'s eyes in Slowbro's tail and thus seeing the {{p|Horsea}}. Lorelei orders {{p|Jynx}} to use {{m|Lovely Kiss}}, paralyzing Sabrina's Alakazam and {{p|Venomoth}}, and pushing her into a fissure. Due to Green's weight, Sabrina has trouble hanging on, and Lorelei suggests cutting off Green's hand, much to Sabrina's disapproval. Jynx uses {{m|Pound}} and sends them and the Pokémon into the hole, but Green wakes up at the last second and uses [[Blasty]]'s {{m|Water Gun}} as a jetpack to escape the hole. At Lorelei's request, Green explains, with an unconscious Sabrina, her reasons. Then a flashback begins, of her talking to a stranger about Lance trying to control a giant, birdlike Pokémon, gaining her interest. Then, she sees [[Pika]] being chased by a {{p|Hitmonlee}} and she decides to follow them. However, when she gets to [[Viridian Forest]] she loses track of them both. Then she meets {{Adv|Yellow}} and discovers her power. Then, after discovering that Yellow knows {{Adv|Red}}, Green gives her the basic of Pokémon training, and thus, two rules: Do not tell anybody of how she met Green and do not tell others her name, which Yellow broke. Suddenly, Green has an idea of using Yellow's hat to prevent their enemies from discovering she is a girl, making Yellow pretend to be a boy. ==Major events== * [[Sabrina]] battles against [[Lorelei]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} (drawing and flashback) * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} (flashback) * {{adv|Silver|Unknown contact of Green}} (flashback) * [[Sabrina]] * [[Lorelei]] * [[Lance]] (silhouette) * {{tc|Camper}} [[Evan]] * {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Jigglypuff}} ([[Jiggly]]; {{adv|Green}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Blastoise}} ([[Blasty]]; {{adv|Green}}'s) * {{p|Rattata}} ([[Ratty]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Alakazam}} ([[Sabrina]]'s) * {{p|Venomoth}} ([[Sabrina]]'s) * {{p|Slowbro}} ([[Lorelei]]'s) ** {{p|Shellder}} (attached to Slowbro; [[Lorelei]]'s) * {{p|Jynx}} ([[Lorelei]]'s) * {{p|Hitmonlee}} ([[Bruno]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Dragonair}} ([[Lance]]'s; silhouette) * {{p|Haunter}} ([[Evan]]'s) * {{p|Dratini}} (flashback) * {{p|Slowking}} (silhouette) ** {{p|Shellder}} (attached to Slowking; silhouette) ==Trivia== *A hint of {{p|Slowking}}'s existence first appeared in this chapter; while Lorelei was musing on Slowbro's enhanced abilities after it had been bitten by Shellder she remarked that Slowpoke would likely have further improved abilities if it was bitten on its head. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 呆河馬|VS Slowbro}} (Taiwan)
